content: Yesus te no Pilatus amun

Awatan ngko dave syeno akokoe nawe, akarijo Yahudi nawe, kuruno Yahudi nawe, vatano kaijinta usisa Anugano Akari Akokoe Yahudi rai nawe, wanugan wayaowa mewen. Umba wo Yesus aokaisy, umba wo augaveta wo aunanto no Gubernur Pilatus ai.
Umba Pilatus po Yesus anajo pare, “Winyirati Akarijo Titi Yahudije pi Win dako?” Umba Yesus po raura nakananto ai pare, “Risy ivae, mamaisyo nya ana ndaura wato rai.”
Umba syeno akokoe wo Yesus aura tantunawi ware Apa ana dave ngkakai mamo manui rave.
Weti Pilatus po Yesus anajo akato pare, “Mbeanimaibe Nyo raura akananto maije jewen? Nyo raen wo naura tantunawi rave!”
Weramu Yesus po ayao inta raura akananto aije ramu, weti Pilatus nantoive Ai.
Pilatus po mangke raugaje Yesus ai indamu kakai
Arono Ono Paska ndea mamaisy, vatano Yahudi nawamo awa koano utavondi raivea nsiridi to mamo wo Gubernur Pilatus anajo indamu po vatano tuna no tanoano makova raije inta apaya irati apa mangke rai.
Arono naije vatane inta apa tame mi Barabas tuna no tanoano makova rai. Barabas umaso pamo makova weye tavondijo vatano wo marova rave pemerinta Roma aije mai ti po vatane inta maubaibe to.
Vatano wanuije ude indamu wo Pilatus anajo inda po vatano tuna no tanoano makova inta apaya irati mai, maisyare po rave no Ono Paska raiveve wemaisy.
Umba Pilatus po manajo pare, “Wapare syo Akarijo Titi Yahudije so apaya wasai rako?”
Weramu Pilatus po raenamo syeno akokoe wo Yesus aunanto ai weye manuga mamuno Yesus ai weye vatano wanui manayanambe Ai.
Umba syeno akokoe wo vatano wanuije umaso manuga raugabe indamu wo Pilatus anajo indamu po Barabas apaya mai.
Umba Pilatus po raura akananto vatano wanuije umawe mai pare, “Maisyare omai ti, animaisye mi syo rave irati vatano wapo awaino Akarijo Titi Yahudije so ai?”
Ugwain ware, “Auseo sawa inyo kapite rai!”
Pilatus po manajo pare, “Weramu ayao kakaije rui mirati Po rave?” Umba vatano wanuije ugwain akoeve akato ware, “Auseo sawa inyo kapite rai!”

Pilatus beker pare po vatano wanuije umaso maveti manayanambe, weti po Barabas apaya mai. Po naite inta matutir indamu wo kaijo waije rave Yesus anepat, umba po aunanto mai indamu wo auseo sawa inyo kapite rai.
Naito Roma wanaikebe Yesus ai
Naite umaso wo Yesus augave siso no Gubernur Pilatus apa yavar. Umba wo awa arakovo naite mawainde wanugan tenambe indamu wanaikebe Yesus ai muno wo ambaon.

Wo ansuno nsintair manawadi inta raugasyo Ai ti po rave, maisyare akarijo titi inta po rave ramaisy. Muno wo anansinao maisyare wanyavi ramaisy rauseo rakariwaibe akari rai, raurata irati sapeo akarijo titi po rave ramaisy.
Umba wo awain ware, “Winyirati Akarijo Titi Yahudi pi Winy!”
Wo isyoe veano Yesus akarije ranepati tutir, wo anyipube, muno wo vukane ranteter no Amun ube ponaibe ware ubeaje Ai.
Wanaikebe Aija jewen, umba wo ansuno nsintaire umawe raugaje aora umba wo taune Apa ansune raugasyo Ai ti po rave akato. Naije umba wo auga ti wusya indamu wo auseo sawa inyo kapite rai.
Yesus auseo sawa inyo kapite rai

Wanyana unanuije ama yasyin, unanta irati vatane inta ai, apa tame mi Simon, opamo to no unat umba pakare no munijo Yerusalem. Naije naito Roma umawe wo antitidi indamu po Yesus apa inyo kapite ranawan. (Simon opamo vatano munijo Kirene inta pije, apa arikainye aya tame mi Aleksandera pe Rupusa pe naye.)
Wo Yesus augaveta no pukame inta rai, ama tame mirati raura ayao Yahudi raijamo Golgota, ama ine mare Akari Pae.
Umba naije wo anggurije raugav, manino mur mo rakokoive, ware wo raunanto Yesus ai indamu Po ramanam, weramu ponayo Po ramanami.
Umba wo auseo sawa inyo kapite rai. Wo aikarae rapatin indamu wo Apa ansune ratodijo taune mansai.
Wo Yesus auseo sawa inyo kapite rai no arono awatan ngkovo uma amije kaimambisy.
Ayaowo ana wanaikebe Ai mamo wo ratoe rauseo no inyo kapite ama von no taiso: Sopamo Akarijo Titi Yahudi.
Umba wo vatano mamune jiruma yauseo syawa atavon, inta sawa no anem ngkov muno inta sawa no anem ngkakai.
Ana nande umaso mamo mamaisyo Ayao Amisye so rai mare: “Opamo ato siso vatano mamune mansai.”
Vatano udetave so wo Yesus aen, makarije rangkiki seo Ai muno wo akaajian ware, “Winyirati nandija nyare Nyo Yavaro Amisye randamisy yara masyote mandei Nyo rauseo ntet akato.
Weti ranivara Winyamo nya vambunine no Nai, weamo nyaje inyo kapite raora indamu Nyo nanasine rapaya kakaije rai!”
Maisyare wemai tavon syeno akokoe nawe kuruno Yahudi nawe wanaikebe Yesus ai ware, “Opamo po vatano kaijinta mapaya kakaije rai, yara taune anasine mamo Po rapaya rai kakai!
Po raurave pare opamo Mesias, Akarijo Titi Israel pije! Weti ranivara wamo aen paje inyo kapite wato raora, wea indati wamanave Ai.” Muno vatano yausea syawa atavone umawe yo akaajian tavon.
Yesus kakai
Masyote yasyin, uma ami abusyinara eane jirum, ananamane nande ntamijo munijo we rai tenambe yava uma amije mandei umba ngkarimu.
Uma ami nanto mandeije so rai, naije Yesus gwain akoeve, po raura ayao Yahudi rai pare, “Eloi Eloi, lama sabakhtani?” ama ine mare, “Sya Amisye, Sya Amisye, mbeanimaibe irati nakirive Inai?”
Vatane inta una no naije wo Yesus apa ayaowe umaso ranaun, umba wo raura ware, “Wadanita, Po anawae Elia awain!”

Vatano no no awa yasyine inta pavave poroto po maimare raugavere umba po raugasya rayansundijo anggurijo nsaisyine rai. Umba po ransuisyo uvi rai, po rareanseo no Yesus awa rai indamu Po rausuv. Umba po raura pare, “Wade ra wamo aen dati, indati Elia de po augaje inyo kapite rai jaje rako jewena e?”
Naije umba Yesus gwain akoeve, umba anawayo karimu, kakai kobe.
Naije kobe kaene nsawa unsanda Yavaro Amisye ama Tanoano Ndandini Dave raije mamo nsaram no vone warae masyo no ate waraya mbe rurumbe.
Arono nait akari Roma wepirati te no inyo kapite ama usye rai po Yesus apa kakaije umaso raen, po raura pare, “Wakoe! Tugae rave, vatane sopamo Arikainyo Amisye pi sop.”
Naijeamo wanya inta nawirati wo ana umawe raerato waravaimbe. No awa yasyine umasoamo Salome muno Maria Magdalena muno Maria kaijinta ntavon, omamo Yakobuso kamurame pe Yosesa pe aya akoya mije.
Wanya sonawamo utavondi Yesus ai muno wo aeranande arono no no Galilea. Umba wanya kaijo wanuije inta utavondi Ai ude no Yerusalem rai tavon.
Yesus antuna
Masyoto namije mamo vatano Yahudi awa masyoto wanakangkanive irati awa masyoto sambaya rai.

Masyote ndea mare ngkaumu kobe, umba vatano munijo Arimatea inta apa tame mi Yusup de. Opamo vatano ato siso Anugano Akari Akokoe Yahudi rai muno vatan tenambe wo aura opamo vatano titi. Po masyoto Amisye de be akarive no mine vone so raije anyuto dei. Umba opamo janive ramu, yara anuga mbambunin ti to kobe no Pilatusa nui indamu po Yesus anasino kopa ranajo ai.
Arono Pilatus po Yesus apa kakaije ranaun, nantoive rai. Weti po vatane inta atutir poroto po nait akari umawe awainde, umba po anajo pare, “Yesus opamo kakai to rako?”
Nait akari umaso po raura pare, “Kakai to.” Weti Pilatus po Yusup amayaro po Yesus anasino kopa rauga kai.

Yusup po ansuno mpopero nsauman ramavun. Umba po Yesus anasino kopa raugaje inyo kapite rai, po ansuno mpoper umawe veano akepan, umba po antuna no aipapo oramo ratotove rai. Umba Yusup po oramo manakoe inta raroya usya ntuna aipapo ama unsanda raora.
Umba Maria Magdalena me, Mariajo Yoses apa akoya me, yo Yesus apa antuna raije raen.
